title: Nolini135's Vanilla
description: This modpack exists beacause I dont like playing others vanilla modpacks beacause of some features so i made mine.
body:
# Why this modpack exists?
this modpack exists for one simple reason: I love vanilla Minecraft, but I never quite enjoy other “vanilla‑style” modpacks. There’s always something that feels off. So I made my own.
This pack is built for players who want the pure Minecraft experience, enhanced just enough to feel smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable.
What This Modpack Aims For
- Keep the gameplay faithful to vanilla
- Add only subtle quality‑of‑life improvements
- Maintain perfect balance for both solo and multiplayer
- Provide a stable, lightweight base for long‑term worlds
What You Can Expect
- Performance and optimization tweaks for a smoother experience
- Small visual and usability upgrades that stay true to Minecraft’s style

# Here are the main mods
